newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW, Porsche in off-road vehicle venture - paper.
newsitem.headline: VW, Porsche in off-road vehicle venture - paper.

text.p: German carmakers Volkswagen AG and Porsche have agreed to cooperate in the construction of an off-road vehicle, German magazine Der Spiegel reported on Saturday.

VW will launch an off-road vehicle in 2001 and Porsche will offer its own version of the vehicle with a different design and a revamped engine, Spiegel said in an advance release of a report to be published in Monday's editions.
VW spokesman Klaus Kocks declined to comment. "As a rule VW does not comment on its future model strategy," Kocks said.
